## `pyrite numerics`

```text
Usage: pyrite numerics [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Manage named numerics presets: sampling, reflections/mosaic, integration.

  Switch sampling with 'pyrite numerics set NAME --sampling adaptive' or '--sampling
  fixed'.

  Attach a preset with 'pyrite profile set PROFILE --numerics NAME'. Profile settings
  (pyrite profile numerics) override the preset. Bundled presets are read-only; clone
  one with 'create NAME --from SOURCE'. Physical models live under pyrite physics.

Options:
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  adopt        Move PROFILE's own fields into new preset...
  create       Create user preset NAME, empty (built-in...
  delete       Delete an unreferenced user preset;...
  list         List presets, their origin, and...
  rename       Rename user preset NAME and update every...
  reset        Return selected fields, or all fields, of...
  set          Set fields of user preset NAME; affects...
  show         Show NAME's stored and effective fields...
  validate     Validate NAME and every profile that...
  energy-grid  Derive and inspect specialist photon-grid artifacts.
```

## `pyrite numerics adopt`

```text
Usage: pyrite numerics adopt [OPTIONS] PROFILE NAME

  Move PROFILE's own fields into new preset NAME and attach it.

  Effective values are unchanged: the preset takes PROFILE's current preset values (if
  any) overlaid with PROFILE's own fields, which are then removed. Multi-value trial-
  count grids are sweep axes and stay on PROFILE.

Options:
  --description TEXT  Display description for the new preset.
  -y, --yes           Skip the standard-profile confirmation.
  --dry-run           Print proposed TOML diff; write nothing.
  -h, --help          Show this message and exit.
```

## `pyrite numerics create`

```text
Usage: pyrite numerics create [OPTIONS] NAME

  Create user preset NAME, empty (built-in defaults) or cloned with --from; validate and
  atomically save, or preview with --dry-run.

Options:
  --from SOURCE                   Clone SOURCE's fields; options then override them.
  --cxr-histories N               Select fixed sampling and set this estimator's history
                                  count.  [x>=1]
  --brem-histories N              Select fixed sampling and set this estimator's history
                                  count.  [x>=1]
  --reflection-families N         Ranked reflection families to resolve.  [x>=1]
  --maximum-reflections N         Cap resolved reflections after family expansion.
                                  [x>=1]
  --mosaic-nodes N                Gauss-Hermite nodes per mosaic tilt axis.  [x>=1]
  --mosaic-route [analytic|mc]    Mosaic broadening route.
  --energy-model [frozen|midpoint]
                                  Transport clock model.
  --maximum-fractional-energy-loss FRACTION
                                  Cap one row's fractional mean energy loss; positive
                                  values require midpoint.  [x>=0.0]
  --sampling [fixed|adaptive]     Select adaptive or fixed sampling. Adaptive options
                                  select adaptive; --cxr-histories or --brem-histories
                                  select fixed. Switching replaces the previous sampling
                                  settings. With no counts, switching to fixed uses 450
                                  CXR and 100 brem histories.
  --brem-target-rse FRACTION      Stop brem independently at this RSE; requires both cxr
                                  and brem observables.  [x>0.0]
  --brem-min-histories N          Brem minimum; defaults to --min-histories. Requires
                                  --brem-target-rse.  [x>=2]
  --brem-max-histories N          Brem maximum, at most --max-histories; defaults to it.
                                  Requires --brem-target-rse.  [x>=2]
  --target-rse FRACTION           Target relative standard error of each watched yield
                                  (0.05 = 5%).  [x>0.0]
  --min-histories N               Smallest count at which the run may stop; a multiple
                                  of --block-histories.  [x>=2]
  --max-histories N               Count at which the run stops regardless, flagged
                                  statistics-limited.  [x>=2]
  --block-histories N             Histories per transport block; the rule is checked at
                                  block ends.  [x>=1]
  --observable [cxr|brem|line]    Yield that must converge; repeat for both. Replaces
                                  the watched set (a new policy watches line and brem).
  --max-history-share FRACTION    Guard: largest share of a yield one history may hold
                                  (default 0.05).  [0.0<x<=1.0]
  --min-effective-histories N     Guard: effective sample size floor (sum m)^2 / sum m^2
                                  (default 100).  [x>=0.0]
  --stability-blocks K            Guard: block ends whose running mean must agree; 0
                                  disables (default 3).  [x>=0]
  --stability-fraction FRACTION   Guard: allowed relative mean drift as a fraction of
                                  the target (default 0.5).  [x>=0.0]
  --pilot-histories N             Pilot count that projects the stopping count and skips
                                  checks until it.  [x>=1]
  --band-ev START,STOP            Monitor band in eV (default: the case's line band).
  --batch-means-band-ev START,STOP
                                  Band in eV for reported per-bin batch-means errors;
                                  costs one extra reduction.
  --description TEXT              Replace the display description.
  --dry-run                       Print proposed TOML diff; write nothing.
  -h, --help                      Show this message and exit.
```

## `pyrite numerics delete`

```text
Usage: pyrite numerics delete [OPTIONS] NAME

  Delete an unreferenced user preset; irreversible.

Options:
  -y, --yes   Delete the exact previewed preset.
  --dry-run   Print proposed TOML diff; delete nothing.
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.
```

## `pyrite numerics list`

```text
Usage: pyrite numerics list [OPTIONS]

  List presets, their origin, and referencing profiles.

Options:
  -o, --output [table|json]  Output format; only json is a stable automation contract.
                             [default: table]
  -h, --help                 Show this message and exit.
```

## `pyrite numerics rename`

```text
Usage: pyrite numerics rename [OPTIONS] NAME NEW_NAME

  Rename user preset NAME and update every referencing profile atomically.

Options:
  --dry-run   Print proposed TOML diff; write nothing.
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.
```

## `pyrite numerics reset`

```text
Usage: pyrite numerics reset [OPTIONS] NAME [FIELDS]...

  Return selected fields, or all fields, of NAME to built-in defaults.

Options:
  NAME
  [FIELDS]...
  --dry-run    Print proposed TOML diff; write nothing.
  -y, --yes    Skip the standard-profile confirmation.
  -h, --help   Show this message and exit.
```

Channeling options (profile [channeling] table):
  --channeling-basis-size INTEGER RANGE
                                  Transverse plane-wave band |h| <= H (table basis_size;
                                  default 16).  [x>=1]
  --channeling-bloch-cells INTEGER RANGE
                                  Bloch-grid supercell size (table bloch_cells; default

## `pyrite numerics energy-grid`

```text
Usage: pyrite numerics energy-grid [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Derive and inspect detector energy-grid inputs by material.

  Examples:
    pyrite numerics energy-grid derive --material mose2 --energy 30,60
    pyrite numerics energy-grid show mose2

  Normal runs size line grids automatically and resolve continuum bounds per case.
  Explicit derivation and stored artifacts are optional specialist tools.

Options:
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  derive  Derive CXR and bremsstrahlung energy-grid bounds.
  show    Show CXR and bremsstrahlung grids together.
  cxr     Inspect PXR/CBS energy grids.
  brem    Inspect bremsstrahlung energy grids.
```

## `pyrite numerics energy-grid derive`

```text
Usage: pyrite numerics energy-grid derive [OPTIONS]

  Optionally derive and install grids locally or remotely.

  Normal runs size line grids automatically and resolve continuum bounds per case. This
  specialist tool requires --material and --energy. Supply geometry and spacing per
  invocation; omitted angles inherit ordinary profile geometry. Explicit artifact
  workflows may optimize nonuniform continuum grids beyond the normal uniform continuum
  spacing.

Options:
  --material KEY,...        Material keys; comma-separated.  [required]
  --energy KEV,...          Beam energies in keV; comma-separated and positive.
                            [required]
  --polar DEG,...           Polar tilts in degrees [0, 90); comma-separated.
  --azimuth DEG,...         Azimuths in degrees [0, 360]; comma-separated.
  --thickness ANGSTROM,...  Crystal thicknesses in angstrom; comma-separated and
                            positive.
  --brem-step EV            Derivation bremsstrahlung spacing in eV; overrides
                            deprecated batch preset.
  --slice-minutes MINUTES   Maximum duration of each self-resubmitting remote slice.
                            [default: 10.0]
  --no-sync                 Skip code upload before remote submission.
  --dry-run                 Print remote batch script and submission command; do not
                            connect or submit.
  --wait                    Wait for remote completion and pull the result.
  --detach                  Return after remote submission.
  --profile NAME            Install derived grids for profile NAME; precedence: flag >
                            configuration > standard.
  --target NAME             Use named remote compute target NAME.
  -R, --remote [TARGET]     Run remotely; bare uses the configured target, =TARGET
                            overrides it.
  -h, --help                Show this message and exit.
```

## `pyrite numerics energy-grid show`

```text
Usage: pyrite numerics energy-grid show [OPTIONS] [MATERIAL]

  Show line and bremsstrahlung grids together.

Options:
  -o, --output [table|json]  Output format; only json is a stable automation contract.
                             [default: table]
  --profile NAME             Resolve profile NAME; precedence: flag > PYRITE_PROFILE >
                             config store > standard.
  -h, --help                 Show this message and exit.
```
